title: NOAA: 2024 was the warmest year in its record since 1850
summary: Climate.gov states 2024 was 1.18 °C above the 20th-century average and 1.35 °C above the 1850–1900 average.
body: NOAA Climate.gov's global-temperature page says 2024 was the warmest year since global records began in 1850, 2.32 °F (1.18 °C) above the 20th-century average, and 2.62 °F (1.35 °C) above the 1850–1900 average it uses as pre-industrial. A nearby sentence on the same page uses slightly different tenths for what may be another comparison. The sentences tied grammatically to 2024 are the ones stored here. NASA's 1.19 °C figure uses a different baseline and a different year. Do not average them into a third number.
